content:
Use @itsPolloAI with the Seedance 2.0 engine to generate e-commerce ad–style videos with a single prompt and single output at ~$0.11 per video.

For product showcase ads, replace a 4-second shoot with a 4-second prompt to generate the clip.

For lifestyle ads, generate the model and scenes together in one output instead of hiring/calling a model.

For ad concepting, input the brand brief and generate 6 different variations in one run.

If you need Seedance 2.0 outputs cheaper, switch platforms (e.g., @itsPolloAI vs Seedance/OpenArt/Topview/Higgsfield/Freepik) since the model is the same and price differences come from platform commission.
